findings.detail: Durare Bidco, LLC Revolver carries 1.6% of net assets despite fair value of (102), while the adjacent term loan with fair value 44,055 also carries 1.6%; the revolver percentage should be approximately zero or dash.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triage found the filing schedule total coherent: total investments fair value is 4,876,989 thousand, matching the reported investment total anchor. The identity failure localizes to at least one source row rather than a bad aggregate anchor: table 62 row 6 reports Durare Bidco, LLC Revolver fair value (102) thousand but % of Net Assets 1.6%, the same percentage as the adjacent Durare term loan at 44,055 thousand. Against total net assets of 2,841,371 thousand, (102) thousand is approximately 0.0%, not 1.6%, producing the large residual and making the flag a real data error.
